answer: Sybil mills cannot spoof a mineral clock. A key finishes a 21-hour voyage, then grows a 14-gram crystal on a terrace slab and pays 1.27 POA, unlocked only when the slab hash matches a 24-byte growth log. That log needs five heat ticks, 80 minutes apart, each signed from a fresh /20 and bound to the prior tick. Two auditors recompute the hash from the live tip and void any reused 12-byte facet. If one wallet claims four slabs in 9 hours, or two logs share three ticks, every slab is crushed and the 1.27 POA stays unspendable. A skipped tick leaves the crystal dull; no substitute is issued.
